priorStatuses.title: Parse the cached payload instead of the wrapper

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body: `getDocument` no longer includes `ctx.tenantId`, so a shared database is queried only by `documentId`. If IDs collide across tenants or another tenant’s ID is supplied, the request can return that tenant’s document, causing cross-tenant state disclosure or nondeterministic selection.
